title: More predictable notifications on GitHub.com
author: Allison
description: Starting December 1, 2026, we’re migrating notifications on GitHub.com over the course of a week to make subscriptions more predictable, correct unexpected behavior, and support the growing scale of activity.… The post More predictable notifications on GitHub.com appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Starting December 1, 2026, we’re migrating notifications on GitHub.com over the course of a week to make subscriptions more predictable, correct unexpected behavior, and support the growing scale of activity. During the rollout, notifications may behave differently for different users.
takeaways: This does not apply to GitHub Enterprise Server.

What is changing Routine activity won’t resubscribe you: Previously, after manually unsubscribing, notification activities such as commenting, submitting a pull request review, changing a thread’s state, or merge queue activity resulted in a re-subscription.
Being mentioned, assigned, or receiving a pull request review request will continue to resubscribe you since those actions ask for your attention.
